headline: Archipelago protects save rooms and difficulty fixes Blarg Station landings
summary: Archipelago v2.1.0 remembers which room belongs to each save slot and refuses a different seed's save, alongside logic and reconnect fixes (#24, #26). Difficulty v1.2.4 fixes Blarg Station's missing ship and Clank at doubled enemy count by leaving room for the level's own objects (#34). Item-randomizer v1.0.4 was also released; all three releases were built against Mod SDK 1.11.0.
highlights: Archipelago logic fixes include the Pilot's Helmet requirement for the O2 Mask and Hoverboard for the Hologuise. Issue #25 asks players to test item requirements, including Trespasser routes on Veldin, Aridia and Batalia.
At enemy count 2, Blarg Station's pool gets no duplicate enemies so its own landing objects fit (#34).
The index now rebuilds after releases, reports broken newest releases instead of silently offering an older one, and records AI assistance per listing (#27, #32, #33).
Co-op crossplay, separate saves, reconnect and host takeover remain in an unmerged draft, explicitly not ready for review or merge (#22).
